753:t_105:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$オックス$$! We'll save the universe with your power!」

753:t_106:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So the son of the incarnation of darkness fights alongside them.」

753:t_106:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$ and $c pulled me out of the darkness.」

753:t_106:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you must make amends.」

753:t_106:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You don't need to tell me that! And I decided long ago how I'll do it!」

753:t_106:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$, you who falsely bear the name of God! Even if it costs me my life, I'll defeat you!」

753:t_106:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「To protect the future of this universe, I'll stake my life on this!!」

753:t_107:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$甲児$$... Having become one with Photon Power, you could in time attain $$シンカ$$ into a higher-dimensional life form.」

753:t_107:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「But to do that, I have to defeat you and save this universe!」

753:t_107:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That will not be necessary. Above all, I have no intention of acknowledging the $$シンカ$$ of one who rejects my salvation.」

753:t_107:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't screw with me! What right do you have to decide something like that!」

753:t_107:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is what a god is! I surpassed the $$御使い$$s with the resolve to bear that much responsibility!」

753:t_107:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll show you my resolve, too!」

753:t_107:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「To defeat you, the greatest and strongest enemy, I'll become one with $$マジンガー$$ and draw out every bit of its power!!」

753:t_107:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even so, you cannot reach a god.」

753:t_107:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm not going to go along with your assumptions! $$マジンガーＺ$$ and I will become a Demon God who surpasses both gods and devils!」

753:t_107:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's showdown time, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! The Demon God of Light will protect this universe!!」

753:t_108:0.en:
$$さやか$$
「I'm part of $c, too! Even if the enemy is a god...!」

753:t_108:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How devoted of you, $$さやか$$. So you find joy in fighting alongside your beloved $$甲児$$.」

753:t_108:2.en:
$$さやか$$
「That's not all! I'm fighting because I can't forgive your existence!」

753:t_108:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「I'm not $$甲児$$'s tagalong! I'll defeat you as a warrior in my own right!」

753:t_108:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What a shame. You reject me, too?」

753:t_108:5.en:
$$さやか$$
「Since this is the last time, I'll say it! That smug smile of yours, like you understand everything... it makes me sick just to look at it!」

753:t_108:6.en:
$$さやか$$
「Here I come, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Prepare yourself!!」

753:t_109:0.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「B-Boss! The enemy is a god, you know!」

753:t_109:1.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「And on top of that, he's huge! There's no way $$ボロット$$ can fight him!」

753:t_109:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「They at least know their place.」

753:t_109:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Shut up! A man is a man because he smashes through that!」

753:t_109:5.en:
$$クロス$$
「Right at the very end, you showed us what kind of man you are.」

753:t_109:8.en:
$$お菊$$
「All right then, let's go. There isn't much time left, either.」

753:t_109:9.en:
$$ボス$$
「Steel yourselves, $$ヌケ$$, $$ムチャ$$! This is our last chance to shine!」

753:t_109:10.en:
$$ボス$$
「Let's do it! We'll show them that even small-fry like us can pull it off if we try!」

753:t_110:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The battle between you and me will be the last True War of this universe.」

753:t_110:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「To think that a battle between higher-dimensional life forms would decide where the universe is headed was presumptuous.」

753:t_110:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Look, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! All life in the universe is trying to move forward toward the future!」

753:t_110:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What a shame. It seems the universe could not wait for that.」

753:t_110:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That heart of resignation is what will destroy the universe! One who bows to fate does not deserve the name of god!」

753:t_110:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「I cast off the name of god as well! And I have decided to stake my life fighting for the future alongside them!」

753:t_110:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Prepare yourself, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! My power of light will strike down the self-righteousness that is you!!」

753:t_111:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It's over, $$竜馬$$. This is the end of the line for your journey of battle.」

753:t_111:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Quit joking. Even if I beat you, my fight goes on.」

753:t_111:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「To live is to fight! As long as I have life, I'll keep fighting!」

753:t_111:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are fundamentally mistaken.」

753:t_111:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your life ends here. In that sense, I'm telling you that your fight is over.」

753:t_111:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I knew it, you're a phony god. That prophecy is way off.」

753:t_111:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're going down right here, by our hands! That's not a prophecy, it's my declaration!」

753:t_111:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I really cannot let that kind of talk pass!」

753:t_111:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Did I make you angry? That's good!」

753:t_111:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come at me with everything you've got, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! The greatest and last battle in the universe... we're the ones who'll win!!」

753:t_112:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So there is another one chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$ here, too.」

753:t_112:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Are you saying I'm the same as $$竜馬$$?」

753:t_112:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$隼人$$... You, too, do not seem to understand your own destiny. That must be the limit of humans.」

753:t_112:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「You can afford to hold forth, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$? Then you'll never keep up with my supersonic world, not by a long shot.」

753:t_112:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「I have no intention of humoring your blather! I'll settle this quickly!」

753:t_112:6.en:
$$隼人$$
「The whole universe is waiting for our victory, after all!!」

753:t_113:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「This is the big showdown for the fate of the entire universe! We can't lose, no way!」

753:t_113:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I alone am permitted to use the word 'absolute.' You would do well to learn that, too.」

753:t_113:2.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You sure about that? After talking so big, you'll be mighty embarrassed if you lose to us, self-proclaimed god!」

753:t_113:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That will not happen. Absolutely not!」

753:t_113:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Then I'll flip your 'absolute' over myself!」

753:t_113:5.en:
$$弁慶$$
「The Daisetsuzan Oroshi, taught to me directly by $$武蔵$$, strong enough to throw even a god! Get a good taste of it!!」

753:t_114:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$マーズ$$... no, $$タケル$$... The time has come for your love to be rewarded.」

753:t_114:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The collapse of the universe is salvation that comes equally to all life. There is no strife there, no inequality, no poverty.」

753:t_114:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And the new universe will become a world brimming with light, through me.」

753:t_114:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't have time to humor your delusions!」

753:t_114:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I thought that you, who fight for love, would understand me.」

753:t_114:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your love isn't for anyone else! It's aimed only at your own self!」

753:t_114:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your salvation is nothing but hypocrisy, forcing your own selfish good intentions on others! We won't lose to a guy like that!」

753:t_114:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Light and darkness, fused into one...! And you'd come at me with that power!」

753:t_114:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「For the many loves that led me this far, and for everything I love, I'll fight in $$ゴッドマーズ$$!」

753:t_114:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's the meaning of my psychic power...! That's the reason I'm alive!!」

753:t_115:1.en:
$$アキラ$$
「I'm counting on you for the attack, $$ナオト$$!」
